subject: Region scope vs hosting preferences - action items and next steps
messages:
From: Luca Romano <luca.romano@nordiheal.eu>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-12T14:02:00Z
Subject: Region scope & hosting preference - follow-up

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from our side and a couple of clarifying questions: 

- Priority: EU patient data must remain within EU jurisdiction for storage and per-region processing.
- Preference: our legal/privacy team is leaning to Private VPC or on-prem for any PHI/medical records. Non-identifiable inference (summaries, model outputs without PHI) could use Hosted in the EU region if latency and bandwidth are acceptable.
- APAC: we currently have a small operations center in Singapore; for APAC traffic we need options that avoid routing EU PII to APAC.

Questions:
1) Do you support an EU-only Private VPC deployment with no cross-region replica?
2) If we choose Redwood Dedicated in eu-west, can we enforce VPC peering such that no traffic leaves eu-west-1?
3) What SOC2/network evidence can you share now (we requested SOC2 earlier) and do you have a template for the network diagram we can send to our infra team?

I've attached our PCI/scope doc for context (NordiHealth_PCI_scope.pdf).

Thanks,
Luca
Head of Platform Engineering
NordiHealth
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Luca Romano <luca.romano@nordiheal.eu>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-13T09:16:00Z
Subject: Re: Region scope & hosting preference - follow-up

Hi Luca — thanks for the clear recap and the PCI scope.

Short answers up front: yes, we can support the patterns you described, but there are tradeoffs and implementation steps we'll need to align on. Below is a short matrix and proposed next steps.

Options + notes:
- Private VPC (EU-only): Full control, no cross-region replication. Suitable if your legal team requires all processing and storage to remain in the EU. This is available as a Private deployment (VPC + customer-managed networking) or an on-prem package for air-gapped needs.
- Dedicated capacity (eu-west reserved): Provides predictable throughput and can be combined with VPC peering and strict egress rules; however some control-plane metadata routing and certain managed services may still originate from our control plane (we can document and scope what stays in-region).
- Hosted API (EU region): Fastest to stand up for non-PHI workloads. We currently have hosted endpoints in eu-west; cross-region fallback is configurable but OFF by default for Private deployments.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Ops deep-dive (30–45m) with your infra/security to review network diagrams and encryption/KMS flows. (We will bring our solutions engineer + infra).
2) Share SOC2 report and network template — attaching current SOC2 export (redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf) and a network requirements template (network-requirements-template.docx).
3) Residency decision matrix (we'll draft) to capture L4 requirements and map to hosting options.
4) Preliminary pricing: Engineering to estimate Dedicated vs Private VPC baseline for a 6-month pilot.

Action items for Redwood (assigned):
- Marissa: send SOC2 + network template (attached).
- Karthik: draft residency decision matrix and include encryption/KMS notes.
- Ben: prepare preliminary Dedicated vs Private pricing for pilot (6-mo).

If that sounds good I'll book the ops deep-dive. Would Wednesday 16th or Thursday 17th morning CET work?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: NordiHealth procurement / technical checklist

X-Internal-Note: following up on Marissa's ask — putting together the residency decision matrix and flagging questions legal/procurement will definitely want answered.

Key technical/procurement points I plan to include:
- KMS: support for customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS) for EU instances? (yes/no + region limitations)
- Dataflow: are KV caches, model shard swaps, or any ephemeral artifacts ever staged outside eu-west during model load/quantization steps? Need explicit guarantees.
- Control plane: confirmation of what control-plane traffic (telemetry/metrics) traverses US vs EU.
- Contractual: SLA for uptime and data residency clause (we should prepare a redline template).

I'll draft the matrix (residency-decision-matrix.xlsx) and share a first pass by Friday. Ben — can you start the Dedicated vs Private price ballpark?

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Luca Romano <luca.romano@nordiheal.eu>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-19T08:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Region scope & hosting preference - follow-up

Appreciate the options and the quick internal alignment. A few clarifications from our infra/legal after reviewing your notes: 

- NordiHealth decision: for production PHI processing we will require Private VPC in the EU (no cross-region replicas). We are open to using Dedicated for non-PHI APAC traffic only if you can guarantee that EU PII is never routed outside EU boundaries.
- We need to validate BAA/SCCs and the SOC2 artefacts. The SOC2 you attached is helpful; please also include a signed attestation page if possible for procurement.
- Network diagram: please fill the network-requirements-template and indicate where KMS is hosted and whether HSM-backed keys are available.
- Timeline: can Redwood stand up a Private VPC pilot within 6–8 weeks? Our timeline to start a pilot is early March.

Please also include preliminary pilot pricing and any assumptions around egress/cross-region data transfers.

Thanks,
Luca
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Luca Romano <luca.romano@nordiheal.eu>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

1) I'll schedule the ops deep-dive for Tuesday 2026-12-21 09:30 CET (invite coming shortly) — this will include our infra lead + solutions eng.
2) Karthik will share the first pass of the residency decision matrix (EOD today).
3) Ben will send a preliminary pricing estimate for a 6-mo Private VPC pilot and a Dedicated fallback for APAC (EOD 2026-12-20).
4) We'll attach a signed attestation page to the SOC2 package and return the completed network template by Tuesday.

If you can share any procurement constraints (PO process, required contract terms) ahead of the ops call that would speed things up.

Attaching: residency-decision-matrix.xlsx (first draft), network-requirements-template.docx, redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf.

Talk soon,
